section.title: Math alphabet / Mathvariant
section.paragraph: TeX's math alphabet macros change font features of (some) letters and digits. Non-alphanumerical symbols, function names, and mathematical text are left unchanged.
MathML 4 defines the mathvariant style attribute, in MathML core, characters from the Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols Unicode block are used.

The mathvariants bold-script, bold-fraktur, and sans-bold are rarely used. They are currently not supported by Docutils's native MathML output. In LaTeX, \mathbfscr and \mathbffrac is supported by the mathalpha package.

Note, that \boldsymbol emboldens also non-alphanumerical symbols.

section.title: Inferred <mrow>s in MathML
section.paragraph: The elements <msqrt>, <mstyle>, <merror>, <mpadded>, <mphantom>, <menclose>, <mtd>, <mscarry>, and <math> treat their contents as a single inferred mrow formed from all their children.
inline: a = \sqrt 2 + x, b = \sqrt{1+x^2}, c = \sqrt\frac{\sin(x)}{23}.

section.title: Scripts and Limits
section.paragraph: Accents should be nearer to the base: \bar a \overline a, \bar l \overline l, \bar i \overline i, \vec{r} \overrightarrow{r}.
Sub- and superscript may be given in any order: x_i^j = x^j_i and \int_0^1 = \int^1_0.
Double exponent: x^{10^4}, r_{T_\mathrm{in}} and x_i^{n^2}.

section.title: Text
section.paragraph: The text may contain non-ASCII characters: n_\text{Stoß}.

Some text-mode LaTeX commands are supported with math_output "html". In other output formats, use literal Unicode: \text{ç é è ë ê ñ ů ž ©} to get the result of the accent macros \text{\c{c} \'e \`e \"e \^e \~n \r{u} \v{z} \textcircled{c}}.
